title: ControlFlow formula layouts
description: math.json inside a .controlflow package (format 1.3) and an HTML export: the typeset layout of every formula the presentation shows, so opening, playing and exporting never typeset. It is a cache: a reader that can typeset may ignore it, and a formula it leaves out is typeset when needed. Glyph outlines are in glyph units (1000 per em, y up); a formula's box, baseline, places and rules are in thousandths of an em with y down from the box's top-left, so multiplying by size / 1000 gives points in the shape's space. See Schema/README.md, "Math".

engine.description: The typesetter and font that made every formula, such as mathjax-4.1.3/newcm. Absent when formulas name their own.

glyphs.description: Each glyph's outline once, by key (font, variant and code point, such as NCM-I-1D44E for an italic a).

additionalProperties.description: The glyph's closed contours, filled together (non-zero).

formulas.description: One entry per distinct formula, in draw order with the first keyframe first.

contour.description: Each point's x, y, inX, inY, outX, outY in turn, handles as offsets from the point, as a shape's points are. Closed.

math.description: The formula, exactly as a shape's math object writes it.

engine.description: The typesetter that made this formula, when the file has no top-level engine.

baseline.description: How far below the box's top the baseline is.

key.description: The glyph's outline in the file's glyphs.

place.description: The matrix [a, b, c, d, tx, ty] from glyph units to the formula's (x' = a x + c y + tx, y' = b x + d y + ty).

tags.description: The \class names the glyph sits in, outermost first.

source.description: The LaTeX the glyph came from.

rules.description: Fraction bars and overlines as [x, y, width, height], in document order. They are wound as the glyphs are.
